text.tspan: Per subject, per rule — decided before any pixels are touched
bbox centre inside the rule's polygon
This is the load control: reusing a verdict until the subject moves
or the TTL expires is what makes judging a whole crowd affordable.
never-judged subjects first, so a crowd
delays re-checks and never first looks
pad for context, then dim everything
1. leading word is yes / no → taken as decisive
2. affirmative vs negative keyword count, negation-aware
3. ambiguous → False. Alert fatigue is the worse failure.
verdict written back to the memo, then published on :5558
